subject: Coord: Dual Ariba/Coupa onboarding + MSA/Order Form signature flow
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@medsync.com>, Procurement IT <procurement@medsync.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Next steps for Ariba + Coupa onboarding + MSA/Order Form redlines

Hi Elena / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Two quick notes so we can get the activation window locked in:

1) Portal coverage: your procurement team asked us to be visible in both Ariba and Coupa. We can support dual activation, but we need clarity on the primary PO ingestion path (Ariba cXML vs Coupa EDI). Please confirm which system will issue POs as the source of truth.

2) Signatures / authority: attached are the current redlines (MSA_Redline_Sojin_v3.pdf, OrderForm_Redline_Sojin_v2.pdf). Legal flagged two signature flows: a) standard signature by an authorized signatory, b) optional purchasing-agent acceptance where the buyer’s PO acknowledgement counts as acceptance. If MedSync prefers (b), we need written confirmation of the purchasing agent authority and the exact PO acknowledgement SLA they require.

3) PO fields & mapping: we identified three mandatory fields that must arrive from the portal for our fulfillment pipeline — vendor-sourced PO number, GL code (if present), and tax/jurisdiction. If you have sample PO XML/EDI files, can you attach them?

4) Timeline: assuming signatures and a single-source PO path, we can target pilot activation in 3 weeks. Dual-portal activation may add 5 business days for mapping and QA.

Action items:
- Elena: confirm primary PO issuer (Ariba or Coupa) and whether PO acknowledgement can serve as contract acceptance (yes/no + SLA).
- Procurement IT: send a sanitized PO example (cXML or EDI) for mapping.
- Kimberly / Jonas: internal legal/ops will review once we get confirmation.

I’ve copied Kimberly and Jonas for legal/ops intake. I’ll consolidate responses and send an updated activation checklist and a DocuSign envelope if MedSync is good with the signature path we propose.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Success, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MSA_Redline_Sojin_v3.pdf (redlines), OrderForm_Redline_Sojin_v2.pdf (redlines)

---
From: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@medsync.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement IT <procurement@medsync.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 11:47:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps for Ariba + Coupa onboarding + MSA/Order Form redlines

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the summary. A few responses from our side:

- Primary PO issuer: Our trading partners issue via Ariba Network for standard buys, but our internal suppliers (and some downstream clinics) sometimes use Coupa. We want both active; Ariba should be considered primary for the enterprise legal relationship.

- Acceptance via PO ack: Our procurement leadership is open to using the PO acknowledgement as acceptance, but legal needs to confirm the SLA. Procurement would prefer a 72-hour ack window, not instantaneous. Is that acceptable to Redwood?

- PO sample: attached an obfuscated cXML sample — procurement@medsync.com said they’ll follow up with an EDI snippet for Coupa flows.

- Signatories: We can provide a purchasing-authority letter for the delegated purchasing agent if required.

Next steps for us: we’ll await the updated redline summary and the DocuSign envelope. Also please confirm whether we should register Redwood as a supplier in both portals in parallel (we can coordinate with our supplier enablement lead if so).

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Ramos
Head of Procurement Operations
MedSync Health
elena.ramos@medsync.com
+1 (212) 555-0199

Attachment: medsync_cxml_sample_obfuscated.xml

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 08:23:41 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps for Ariba + Coupa onboarding + MSA/Order Form redlines

Folks —

Thanks for the context. Quick internal notes from Legal/Ops after scanning the redlines and the cXML sample:

1) PO acknowledgement as acceptance: Legal is OK with a PO-ack acceptance flow provided MedSync confirms the 72-hour SLA in writing and allows Redwood to fallback to signature if ack fails within that window. We’ll add a short clause to the Order Form to capture the 72-hour ack as an alternate acceptance path.

2) Signature authority: the purchasing-agent letter that Elena mentioned will suffice to validate delegated acceptance. We’ll need the letter on MedSync letterhead and a contact for verification.

3) Data mapping: Mateo — please work with Procurement IT to map the cXML elements to our fulfillment fields. Key fields: BuyerOrderID -> redwood_po_number, TotalNetAmount, TaxAmount, AccountingCode (GL) if present, and ShipTo/ShipFrom IDs. Create a mapping doc and share by Mon 12/6.

4) DocuSign: we’ll prepare a combined envelope for the MSA + Order Form (redlined) to cover the signature path. If they elect PO-ack acceptance, we’ll mark the Order Form with the 72-hour clause and include fallback language.

I’ll route the proposed language to Soojin for consolidation before we send to Elena.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@medsync.com>, Procurement IT <procurement@medsync.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:03:12 -0800
Subject: Final: Activation checklist + DocuSign + Registration links

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the cXML sample. Per internal review, here’s the consolidated action plan and links to keep us moving:

Summary decisions
- Ariba is confirmed as primary PO issuer; Coupa will be an active secondary path.
- MedSync confirmed willingness to allow PO-ack as acceptance with a 72-hour acknowledgement SLA. Legal will provide the purchaser-authority letter.

Immediate action items (owner & ETA)
- Procurement IT (MedSync): share Coupa EDI sample by Thu 12/10. (procurement@medsync.com)
- MedSync Legal: provide purchasing-authority letter (PDF) by Thu 12/10. (Elena)
- Mateo (Redwood): deliver mapping doc (cXML/EDI -> Redwood fields) by Mon 12/6.
- Kimberly (Redwood Legal): finalize 72-hour acceptance clause and update Order Form by Mon 12/6.
- Soojin (Redwood): send DocuSign envelope once Kimberly signs off; target envelope sent by Wed 12/9.

Links / resources
- DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=FAKE-ENVELOPE-12345
- Ariba registration (MedSync supplier intake): https://www.ariba.com/buyer/medsync/registration
- Coupa activation ticket: https://support.coupa.com/activation/TICKET-1128
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/78934

Notes on PO routing and technical constraints
- If Ariba is the primary, our ingestion layer will accept Ariba POs directly into the production pipeline. For Coupa-sourced POs, we’ll route via our secondary adapter which requires an EDI 850/PO XML sample for mapping. Dual activation is doable but will require one QA cycle per portal.
- If an ack is not received within 72 hours, Redwood will open a pre-flight hold and notify MedSync procurement ops; Redwood’s fallback is manual signature acceptance within 10 business days to avoid shipment delays.

Next meeting suggestion: 30-minute stand-up with Procurement IT + Mateo + Jonas next Tuesday 12/7 at 10:00am PT to review the sample mappings. I’ll send a calendar invite once I hear availability.

Please reply with confirmations or edits; if everything looks good I’ll move forward with DocuSign and supplier registrations.

Best,
Soojin
Partner Success, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced previously: MSA_Redline_Sojin_v3.pdf, OrderForm_Redline_Sojin_v2.pdf
